Senior Finance Analyst Job at Visa Incorporated




        
    

        
        Visa Incorporated operates the world's largest retail electronic payments network and is one of the most recognized global financial services brands. Visa facilitates global commerce through the transfer of value and information among financial institutions, merchants, consumers, businesses and government entities.

We offer a range of branded payment product platforms, which our financial institution clients use to develop and offer credit, charge, debit, prepaid and cash access programs to cardholders. Visa's card platforms provide consumers, businesses, merchants and government entities with a secure, convenient and reliable way to pay and be paid in over 200 countries and territories.
     

            
    



We are recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Senior Finance Analyst

Job Location: Plateau

Key Responsibilities


	Review walkthrough documentation, test control effectiveness, meet control owners, and report identified issues.
	Support IT controls meetings with control owners, external auditors, and SOX team members.
	Document test results in Visa workpaper templates for SOX team and external auditor review.
	Assess control exceptions with management, communicate issues, and support remediation action plans.
	Communicate clearly with control owners, IT teams, auditors, and SOX stakeholders.
	Contribute to planning and executing the annual IT SOX program.
	Support non-SOX project execution and documentation as needed.
	Manage day-to-day control-related interactions with external auditors.
	Visa requires at least 4 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.


Qualifications
Basic Qualifications:


	7+ years of relevant experience with a relevant bachelor’s degree, or 5+ years with an advanced degree such as a Master’s or MBA.
	ACCA, CISA, or other relevant qualification preferred.


Analytical And Problem Solving Skills:


	Strong problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis and issue/risk resolution.
	Ability to identify opportunities to strengthen standards, controls, and practical solutions.
	Proven ability to use AI tools to improve efficiency and deliver measurable results.


Communication:


	Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with messaging tailored to the audience.
	Ability to clearly explain control assessments to internal and external stakeholders.


Interpersonal Skills:


	Strong collaborator with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.
	Detail-oriented, conscientious, and highly accountable team player.
	Ability to recommend practical solutions that reduce risk.


Project Management:


	Strong organizational and time management skills.
	Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and various AI tools.

  "title": "Logistics Manager",
  "description": "Lightread Consulting - Our client, a growing company operating in the furniture and interior design space, is&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Logistics Manager

Job Location: Chevron, Lekki - Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Furniture and Interior Design

About the Role


	They are seeking an experienced and highly organised Logistics Manager to oversee the efficient movement, storage, delivery, and installation of furniture, interior materials, equipment, and other project related items.
	The ideal candidate will have strong experience coordinating logistics operations, managing drivers and delivery teams, planning routes, monitoring inventory movement, and ensuring that products reach clients and project sites safely and on schedule.
	The role requires someone who is highly organised, commercially aware, solution oriented, and capable of working in a fast paced environment where delivery timelines and customer experience are critical.


Key Responsibilities
Logistics Operations:


	Plan and coordinate daily logistics activities, including deliveries, pickups, transfers, and movement of furniture and interior materials.
	Develop efficient delivery schedules and routes to minimise delays, transportation costs, and unnecessary vehicle movement.
	Coordinate the movement of furniture from the workshop, warehouse, showroom, suppliers, and project sites.
	Ensure all deliveries are properly documented and completed within agreed timelines.
	Monitor deliveries from dispatch through to final delivery and installation.
	Coordinate logistics for multiple interior projects simultaneously.


Fleet and Driver Management:


	Manage company vehicles, drivers, dispatch riders, and third party logistics providers.
	Prepare and maintain driver schedules and vehicle allocation plans.
	Monitor vehicle usage, fuel consumption, servicing, repairs, and maintenance.
	Ensure all company vehicles are properly maintained and available when required.
	Monitor driver performance, punctuality, conduct, and compliance with company policies.
	Ensure drivers follow approved routes and maintain proper delivery documentation.


Furniture Delivery and Installation:


	Coordinate the safe transportation of furniture, fittings, d&eacute;cor items, and interior materials.
	Ensure furniture is properly packaged, loaded, secured, transported, and unloaded to prevent damage.
	Coordinate with installation teams to ensure furniture and interior items arrive at project sites before or alongside installation teams.
	Conduct or coordinate delivery checks to ensure items delivered correspond with approved orders and project requirements.
	Escalate cases involving damaged, missing, incorrect, or delayed items and coordinate appropriate resolution.


Inventory and Warehouse Coordination:


	Work closely with the warehouse and operations teams to monitor the movement of stock.
	Maintain accurate records of items dispatched, delivered, returned, transferred, or awaiting delivery.
	Ensure proper documentation for all movement of furniture and materials.
	Coordinate returns and reverse logistics when required.
	Support periodic stock counts and reconciliation of logistics related inventory.


Vendor and Third Party Management:


	Identify and coordinate reliable third party transporters and logistics service providers when required.
	Negotiate transportation rates and ensure logistics costs remain within approved budgets.
	Monitor the performance of external logistics providers and address service failures promptly.
	Maintain a database of approved logistics vendors, drivers, and service providers.


Customer and Project Coordination:


	Work closely with the sales, project management, design, warehouse, and installation teams to coordinate deliveries.
	Communicate delivery schedules to relevant internal teams and clients where required.
	Ensure clients receive professional and courteous service during deliveries.
	Resolve delivery related complaints and escalate complex issues appropriately.
	Provide regular updates on ongoing deliveries and project logistics.


Key Performance Indicators
The successful candidate will be measured on:


	On time delivery rate
	Delivery accuracy
	Reduction in damaged goods during transportation
	Logistics cost management
	Vehicle utilisation and maintenance
	Driver performance and compliance
	Customer satisfaction with delivery experience
	Accuracy of logistics documentation
	Reduction in delivery delays and failed deliveries
	Effective coordination of project site deliveries


Requirements


	Bachelor&#39;s Degree or OND in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Transport Management, Operations Management, or a related field.
	3 to 5 years of relevant experience in logistics, fleet management, supply chain, or operations.
	Experience in furniture, interior design, construction, building materials, retail, e commerce, or a related industry will be an advantage.
	Demonstrated experience managing drivers, delivery teams, vehicles, and third party logistics providers.
	Strong knowledge of Lagos routes, particularly Lekki and surrounding areas.
	Good understanding of inventory movement and delivery documentation.
	Strong organisational and coordination skills.
	Excellent problem solving and communication abilities.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple deliveries and project timelines simultaneously.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other logistics or inventory management tools.
	Ability to analyse logistics costs and identify opportunities for operational efficiency.


Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be:


	Highly organised and detail oriented
	Proactive and solution oriented
	Firm but professional when managing drivers and logistics vendors
	Comfortable working in a fast paced environment
	Strong in planning and execution
	Customer focused
	Commercially aware
	Able to coordinate multiple teams and priorities effectively
	Familiar with the movement and handling of high value furniture and interior products.


Salary
N150,000 - N250,000 monthly.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should forward their CV and Cover Letter highlighting relevant experience in logistics, fleet management, supply chain, furniture, interior design, construction, retail, or related industries to: lightreadservices@gmail.com using theication&nbsp;Job Position as the subject of the email.",

title: Job Openings at Efezi Southsea Nigeria Limited
content:
Efezi Southsea Nigeria Limited is a hospitality consultant company incorporated in 2009 primarily to provide hospitality services to small and medium hotels.

We are recruiting to fill the following positions below:

1.) General Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Key Duties
Overall Hotel Management:


	Oversee all departments and hotel operations.
	Ensure the hotel operates efficiently and according to established standards.
	Implement policies, procedures, and operational strategies.


Financial Management:
     

            
    




	Monitor hotel revenue, expenses, profit, and cash flow.
	Prepare and manage annual budgets and financial targets.
	Control operational costs and reduce unnecessary expenditure.
	Review daily, weekly, and monthly financial and sales reports.


Revenue & Business Development:


	Develop strategies to increase room occupancy, revenue, and profitability.
	Monitor room rates, sales performance, and market trends.
	Build relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, event organizers, and other business partners.
	Drive marketing and promotional initiatives.


Staff & Human Resources Management:


	Supervise department heads and senior management staff.
	Ensure proper recruitment, training, deployment, and performance management.
	Establish staff discipline and ensure compliance with hotel policies.
	Conduct management meetings and performance reviews.


Guest Experience:


	Ensure high standards of guest service and satisfaction.
	Personally handle serious guest complaints and sensitive situations.
	Monitor guest feedback and implement corrective measures.
	Maintain the hotel's reputation and service standards.


Operational Supervision:


	Monitor Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Kitchen, Maintenance, Security, Accounts, and other departments.
	Conduct regular inspections of rooms and hotel facilities.
	Ensure proper coordination between departments.


Quality & Compliance:


	Ensure compliance with health, safety, fire, licensing, and regulatory requirements.
	Maintain hotel SOPs and service standards.
	Ensure proper documentation and operational records.


Procurement & Asset Management:


	Approve or supervise major purchases and procurement activities.
	Monitor inventory, equipment, furniture, and other hotel assets.
	Prevent wastage, misuse, and losses.


Maintenance & Facility Management:


	Ensure all hotel facilities and equipment are properly maintained.
	Follow up on major repairs and preventive maintenance.
	Ensure the hotel environment remains safe, functional, and presentable.


Reporting & Management:


	Prepare regular reports for the hotel owner/board.
	Present operational and financial performance updates.
	Make recommendations on business improvements and investments.
	Represent the hotel at external meetings and industry engagements.


Key Performance Areas
A General Manager is typically accountable for:


	Revenue and profitability
	Occupancy and sales growth
	Guest satisfaction
	Staff performance and discipline
	Cost control
	Operational efficiency
	Quality and service standards
	Compliance and risk management
	Overall hotel reputation.


Salary
N50,000 monthly.

Application Closing Date: 22nd September, 2026.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Applications to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

 

2.) Hotel Operations Manager

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Job Summary


	The Hotel Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the hotel's day-to-day operations and ensuring that all departments deliver efficient, professional, and consistent services. The Operations Manager works closely with the General Manager and Heads of Departments to maintain high operational standards, improve guest satisfaction, control costs, and achieve the hotel's business objectives.


Key Roles & Responsibilities
Overall Hotel Operations:


	Oversee the daily operations of the hotel and ensure smooth coordination between all departments.
	Ensure that Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Maintenance, Security, Laundry, and other departments operate efficiently.
	Monitor departmental performance and ensure compliance with approved operational standards.
	Ensure that all hotel Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are properly implemented.


Guest Service & Satisfaction:


	Ensure that guests receive excellent and consistent service throughout their stay.
	Monitor guest feedback, reviews, and complaints.
	Resolve guest complaints and operational issues promptly and professionally.
	Ensure that service standards are maintained across all guest touchpoints.


Staff Supervision & Leadership:


	Supervise and coordinate Heads of Departments and operational staff.
	Ensure adequate staffing levels across departments.
	Monitor staff attendance, punctuality, grooming, conduct, and performance.
	Support staff training, coaching, discipline, and development.
	Promote teamwork, professionalism, and accountability.


Operational Standards & Quality Control:


	Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms, public areas, restaurants, kitchens, offices, and other hotel facilities.
	Identify operational weaknesses and implement corrective measures.
	Ensure cleanliness, maintenance, safety, and service standards are consistently maintained.
	Develop and enforce operational checklists and quality-control procedures.


Revenue & Cost Control:


	Work with the General Manager and Accountant to improve hotel profitability.
	Monitor departmental expenses and operational costs.
	Identify areas of wastage and implement cost-saving measures.
	Monitor room occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), and other operational performance indicators.
	Support strategies aimed at increasing revenue and improving hotel performance.


Front Office & Room Operations:


	Monitor Front Office operations and ensure efficient check-in and check-out procedures.
	Ensure accurate room status and effective room allocation.
	Work closely with Housekeeping to ensure rooms are cleaned and released promptly.
	Monitor room availability, out-of-order rooms, complimentary rooms, discounts, and VIP arrangements.


Food & Beverage Operations:


	Monitor restaurant, bar, kitchen, banquet, and event operations.
	Ensure food quality, service standards, hygiene, and customer satisfaction.
	Work with the F&B Manager/Chef to control food costs and minimize wastage.
	Ensure proper stock handling and accountability within F&B operations.


Maintenance & Facility Management:


	Monitor the condition of hotel facilities, equipment, electrical systems, plumbing, air-conditioning, generators, and other critical infrastructure.
	Ensure maintenance issues are reported and resolved promptly.
	Work closely with the Maintenance/Engineering team to implement preventive maintenance programmes.
	Ensure the hotel environment remains safe, functional, and presentable.


Security & Safety:


	Ensure adequate security measures are maintained throughout the hotel.
	Work with the Security Department to prevent theft, unauthorized access, and other risks.
	Ensure compliance with fire safety, emergency procedures, and workplace safety requirements.
	Ensure incidents are properly documented and reported to management.


Inventory & Procurement:


	Monitor hotel inventory levels and ensure proper stock control.
	Work with Procurement and Stores to ensure timely availability of operational supplies.
	Monitor stock usage and investigate unusual shortages or wastage.
	Ensure proper documentation of purchases, receipts, and stock movements.


Policies, Procedures & Compliance:


	Implement and enforce hotel policies and operational procedures.
	Ensure compliance with applicable hospitality, health, safety, and regulatory requirements.
	Review existing procedures and recommend improvements where necessary.
	Ensure all departments maintain proper operational records and documentation.


Reporting & Management Support:


	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports for the General Manager.
	Monitor departmental KPIs and provide recommendations for improvement.
	Attend management meetings and provide updates on operational performance.
	Escalate major operational challenges and recommend practical solutions.


Business Development & Performance Improvement:


	
	Support the General Manager in developing strategies to improve hotel performance.
	
	
	Identify opportunities to improve guest satisfaction, occupancy, revenue, and service quality.
	
	
	Monitor competitor activities and industry trends.
	
	
	Support promotional activities and initiatives designed to increase hotel business.
	


Required Qualifications


	Bachelor's Degree or HND in Hospitality Management, Hotel Management, Business Administration, Tourism Management, or a related field.
	Minimum of 8 years of practical experience in the hotel/hospitality industry.
	Relevant professional certification in hospitality management is an added advantage.
	Strong experience in hotel operations, preferably with previous experience in a supervisory or management position.
	Previous experience as a Hotel Operations Manager, Assistant Operations Manager, Hotel Manager, or senior departmental manager is highly desirable.
	Extensive knowledge of Front Office, Housekeeping, Food & Beverage, Maintenance, Security, and general hotel operations.
	Strong knowledge of hotel SOPs, service standards, quality control, and guest relations.
	Good understanding of hotel revenue and cost-control principles.
	Proficiency in hotel Property Management Systems (PMS) and Microsoft Office applications.
	Strong leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
	Ability to work under pressure and manage operational emergencies effectively.
	Strong interpersonal and conflict-resolution skills.
	High level of professionalism, integrity, discipline, and accountability.


Experience Requirements:


	Minimum of 8 years of proven practical experience in the hotel/hospitality industry, with substantial hands-on experience in hotel operations and departmental coordination.


Key Competencies:


	Hotel Operations Management
	Team Leadership & Staff Supervision
	Guest Relations & Customer Service
	Quality Control
	SOP Implementation
	Revenue & Cost Control
	Front Office Operations
	Housekeeping Coordination
	Food & Beverage Operations
	Facility & Maintenance Coordination
	Inventory & Procurement Control
	Health, Safety & Security
	Staff Training & Development
	Problem Solving & Decision Making
	Performance Management
	Communication & Interpersonal Skills
	Integrity & Accountability.


Application Closing Date: 8th September, 2026.

 

 

3.) Accountant

Job Location: Ikeja, Lagos

Key Duties
Financial Records:


	Maintain accurate records of all hotel financial transactions.
	Record daily income, expenses, purchases, payments, and receipts.
	Maintain proper ledgers and accounting documentation.


Daily Revenue Control:


	Verify daily room revenue, restaurant, bar, laundry, events, and other departmental income.
	Reconcile cash, POS, bank transfers, and other payment channels.
	Review daily sales and revenue reports for discrepancies.


Accounts Receivable & Payable:


	Monitor money owed to the hotel by guests, companies, and corporate clients.
	Follow up on outstanding debts and prepare receivable reports.
	Process and monitor payments to suppliers and service providers.


Bank & Cash Reconciliation:


	Reconcile hotel bank accounts regularly.
	Monitor cash collections and deposits.
	Investigate and resolve differences between records, bank statements, and actual collections.


Payroll:


	Prepare or assist with monthly payroll.
	Verify staff salaries, deductions, allowances, advances, and other payments.
	Ensure payroll records are accurate and properly documented.


Budget & Cost Control:


	Assist management in preparing budgets.
	Monitor departmental expenses against approved budgets.
	Identify unnecessary expenditure, wastage, and financial irregularities.


Inventory & Stock Control:


	Work with Stores, Kitchen, Housekeeping, and other departments to monitor inventory.
	Check stock purchases, issues, consumption, and variances.
	Investigate unusual stock losses or discrepancies.


Financial Reporting:


	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports.
	Prepare income statements, expense reports, cash-flow information, and other management reports.
	Provide management with accurate financial information for decision-making.


Audit & Internal Control:


	Maintain proper financial controls and accounting procedures.
	Support internal and external audits.
	Investigate financial discrepancies and suspected irregularities.
	Ensure supporting documents are available for all transactions.


Tax & Statutory Compliance:


	Maintain records required for tax and statutory obligations.
	Assist with preparation and submission of relevant statutory returns.
	Keep financial documentation ready for regulatory or tax inspections.


Management Support:


	Advise the General Manager on financial matters.
	Provide financial analysis for hotel operations and business decisions.
	Participate in management meetings and recommend ways to improve profitability.


Key Performance Areas


	Accurate financial records
	Daily revenue reconciliation
	Effective cash and bank control
	Cost reduction and expense monitoring
	Timely financial reporting

title: Job Openings at Emmix Global Limited
content:
Emmix global limited offers consultancy on conceptualization, development and project management services for independent hotel,restaurant and bar owners. It is most ideal if Emmix global limited is involved from the early stages of a project to enable our team to guide the development of the project. This usually also to ensure the brand philosophy and values have influence over various facets of the project to deliver a holistic and exceptional finished product

We are recruiting to fill the following position below:

1.) Head of Production / Production Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Head of Production / Production Manager to oversee our manufacturing operations and ensure that products are produced efficiently, consistently, and to the required quality standards.
	The Head of Production will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing the company's entire production process — from the receipt of materials through manufacturing, finishing, quality control, and final delivery.
	The successful candidate will lead the production team, manage production schedules, improve manufacturing processes, control production costs, minimize waste, and ensure that all products meet the company's quality and design specifications.


Key Responsibilities
Production Management:


	Plan, organize, and oversee daily furniture production activities.
	Develop and manage production schedules to meet customer orders and delivery deadlines.
	Coordinate the production of different furniture lines and projects.
	Allocate labour, machinery, materials, and other resources effectively.
	Monitor production progress and resolve delays or operational challenges.
	Ensure designs and production specifications are accurately translated into finished products.


Team Leadership:


	Lead, supervise, and manage production staff, craftsmen, technicians, and workshop personnel.
	Set clear performance expectations and monitor team productivity.
	Train and develop production staff on proper processes, quality standards, and workplace procedures.
	Promote discipline, teamwork, accountability, and a strong work ethic.
	Conduct regular performance reviews and identify training and development needs.


Quality Control:


	Establish and maintain high-quality standards throughout the production process.
	Inspect finished and semi-finished products to ensure they meet design and quality specifications.
	Identify production defects and implement corrective measures.
	Work closely with the Design Team to resolve technical and production-related design issues.
	Ensure consistency in dimensions, finishing, materials, construction, and overall product quality.


Materials & Inventory:


	Work closely with procurement and stores teams to ensure timely availability of production materials.
	Monitor the use of wood, fabrics, foam, metal, hardware, finishes, and other production materials.
	Reduce material waste, damage, and unnecessary production costs.
	Ensure proper handling, storage, and usage of production materials.
	Assist in establishing accurate material requirements and production costing.


Process Improvement & Cost Control:


	Identify opportunities to improve production efficiency and reduce costs.
	Develop and implement standard operating procedures for production activities.
	Monitor production output, labour efficiency, material usage, and wastage.
	Introduce improved tools, techniques, processes, and equipment where appropriate.
	Track production KPIs and provide regular reports to management.
	Ensure production targets are achieved within agreed budgets and timelines.


Health & Safety:


	Ensure that the workshop and production environment is safe, clean, and properly organized.
	Enforce appropriate safety procedures when operating machinery and tools.
	Ensure employees use appropriate personal protective equipment.
	Identify and address potential workplace hazards.
	Promote a culture of safety and responsibility across the production team.


Cross-Departmental Collaboration:


	Work closely with the Design Team to ensure products are practical and production-ready.
	Collaborate with Procurement and Stores to maintain adequate material availability.
	Work with Sales and Customer Service teams to understand production requirements and delivery deadlines.
	Coordinate with management on production capacity, challenges, and resource requirements.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The successful candidate will be expected to monitor and improve:


	Production output and efficiency.
	On-time completion of production orders.
	Product quality and defect rates.
	Material wastage.
	Production costs.
	Labour productivity.
	Machine and equipment utilization.
	Rework and rejected products.
	Workplace safety.
	Overall production capacity and team performance.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree / HND in Industrial Production, Manufacturing, Engineering, Industrial Design, Furniture Technology, Operations Management, or a related field.
	5+ years of experience in production or manufacturing management, preferably within the furniture, woodworking, interior, or related manufacturing industry.
	Proven experience managing a production team or workshop.
	Strong understanding of furniture manufacturing processes and materials.
	Practical knowledge of woodworking, upholstery, finishing, joinery, metalwork, or other relevant furniture production processes.
	Strong understanding of production planning, quality control, inventory management, and cost control.
	Good knowledge of machinery, tools, workshop operations, and manufacturing processes.
	Strong leadership and people-management skills.
	Excellent organizational and problem-solving abilities.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet tight production deadlines.
	Strong communication and reporting skills.
	Good knowledge of workplace health and safety practices.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other production or inventory management tools is an advantage.


Key Qualities
We are looking for someone who is:


	Hands-on and operationally strong.
	A confident leader who can manage and motivate a production team.
	Highly organized and results-oriented.
	Practical and solutions-focused.
	Detail-oriented and committed to quality.
	Commercially aware and cost-conscious.
	Comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
	Able to identify problems quickly and take decisive corrective action.
	Passionate about furniture manufacturing and craftsmanship.





What We Offer


	Competitive salary.
	Opportunity to lead a growing furniture production operation.
	Professional growth and development opportunities.
	A collaborative and performance-driven working environment.
	Opportunity to contribute to improving and scaling the company's manufacturing operations.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using “Application for Head of Production / Production Manager” as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

 

2.) Design Lead Team (Industrial Design)

Job Location: Abuja
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are afurniture company focused on creating functional, innovative, and high-quality furniture products. We are looking for a creative and experienced Design Lead with a background in Industrial Design to lead our design team and drive the development of new furniture products from concept to production.
	The Design Lead will oversee the company’s product design process, lead the design team, develop innovative furniture concepts, and ensure that designs are functional, aesthetically appealing, commercially viable, and suitable for manufacturing.
	The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of industrial/product design, furniture design, materials, manufacturing processes, and design software, with the ability to translate ideas into practical, production-ready products.


Key Responsibilities


	Lead and coordinate the design team and oversee day-to-day design activities.
	Develop innovative furniture concepts in line with the company’s brand and market needs.
	Take products from initial concept and sketches through prototyping, refinement, and production.
	Create and review technical drawings, specifications, and product documentation.
	Develop 2D and 3D designs, models, and product presentations.
	Collaborate closely with production, procurement, sales, and management teams.
	Select appropriate materials, finishes, hardware, and construction methods for furniture products.
	Ensure designs are functional, durable, ergonomic, aesthetically appealing, and cost-effective.
	Work with manufacturers and production teams to ensure designs can be produced accurately.
	Review prototypes and recommend improvements before final production.
	Research furniture trends, materials, technologies, and customer preferences.
	Maintain and develop the company’s product design standards and guidelines.
	Manage multiple design projects while meeting deadlines and production requirements.
	Mentor junior designers and provide feedback to improve their technical and creative skills.
	Ensure consistency across the company's furniture collections and product range.


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree/HND in Industrial Design, Product Design, Furniture Design, or a related field.
	3–5 years of relevant experience in industrial, product, or furniture design.
	Proven experience designing furniture or physical consumer products.
	Strong understanding of furniture construction, materials, manufacturing techniques, and production processes.
	Proficiency in relevant design and 3D modelling software such as AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Rhino, SketchUp, Fusion 360, 3ds Max, or similar tools.
	Strong understanding of design principles, ergonomics, proportions, materials, and functionality.
	Ability to create technical drawings and production-ready specifications.
	Strong creative, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
	Good understanding of cost-conscious and commercially viable product design.
	Strong leadership and project-management skills.
	Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
	A strong portfolio of industrial, product, or furniture design projects is required.


Key Qualities
The ideal candidate should be:


	Creative and innovative.
	Highly detail-oriented.
	Commercially minded.
	Practical and solution-focused.
	Passionate about furniture and product design.
	Comfortable working with production and manufacturing teams.
	Able to lead and inspire a design team.
	Able to balance aesthetics, functionality, quality, and production cost.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary.
	Opportunity to lead and develop a growing design team.
	Creative freedom to develop new furniture products.
	Professional growth and development opportunities.
	A collaborative and innovative working environment.
	Opportunity to contribute directly to the development of the company's furniture collection.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

 

 

3.) Accountant

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)
Employment Type: Full-time

Recruiterdashboard access

Job Summary


	The Accountant will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, monitoring income and expenses, preparing financial reports, managing accounts payable and receivable, and ensuring compliance with applicable accounting and tax requirements.


Key Responsibilities


	Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounting records and financial transactions.
	Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
	Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable.
	Record sales, purchases, expenses, payroll, and other financial transactions.
	Monitor cash flow and prepare cash-flow reports.
	Reconcile bank statements and company accounts regularly.
	Track inventory costs and assist with stock valuation and costing of furniture products.
	Monitor customer payments and follow up on outstanding receivables.
	Process supplier invoices and ensure timely payments.
	Assist with budgeting, financial forecasting, and cost control.
	Monitor production and operational costs and identify areas of unnecessary expenditure.
	Prepare documents and information required for audits and tax filings.
	Ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards, tax regulations, and company policies.
	Maintain proper filing and documentation of financial records.
	Provide management with financial information to support business decisions.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree / HND in Accounting, Finance, or a related field with 2 – 5 years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in manufacturing, furniture, retail, or a related industry.
	Professional accounting qualification or part-qualification is an advantage.
	Good knowledge of accounting principles and financial reporting.
	Experience with accounting software and Microsoft Excel.
	Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
	Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
	Ability to manage confidential financial information.
	Good communication and organizational skills.
	Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.


What We Offer


	Competitive salary.
	Professional growth and development opportunities.
	A supportive and collaborative work environment.
	Opportunity to contribute to the growth of a growing furniture business.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief cover letter to: [email protected] using “Application for Accountant” as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
